metrics_finding.finding: The CPU utilization of the notification-service increased significantly during the failure window, from a baseline of 0.00964 to a failure value of 0.02779.

evidence_summary.summary: The CPU utilization of the notification-service increased significantly during the failure window, indicating a possible cause for the incident.

report.suggested_fix: Monitor CPU utilization of the notification-service and consider increasing its resources or optimizing its configuration to prevent similar incidents.

report_text.en: The root cause of the incident is likely related to a high CPU utilization of the notification-service. Monitoring its performance and adjusting its configuration may help prevent future incidents.
report_text.hi: अप्रत्याशित घटना की मुख्य कारण पुष्टि करने के लिए, संदेह है कि नोटिफिकेशन सेवा की CPU उपयोग बढ़ गई है। इस सेवा की प्रदर्शन पर निगरानी रखें और इसकी सेटिंग्स को समायोजित करके भविष्य में ऐसी घटनाओं को रोकने की कोशिश करें।
